Read: card #35215 body and all nine comments (list 7000507491, ruling record 7001649654, claim 7003048676, dev report 7004014636), the per-line tables the ruling record points at, the PR body and its one comment, the net diff against `main` (20 files, +49 −61), and the check-runs on this head. The whole diff is in scope: 19 `hits` files and the ratchet table that enforces their line counts. No remainder for a separate ACCEPT.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-sets and published surface: none changed. The diff is seat-facing prose under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` plus nine ceiling values in one ratchet table. No package, schema, label object, workflow or script logic moves. Right.
- Ruled rows applied, each checked against the table row: G-A 29 of 34 (A1: L1 L3 L11 L13 L14 L15 L17 L18 L44; A2: L21 L22 L30 L33 L34 L38 L39 L42 L43 L35 L31 L32 L37; A3: L10 L16 L26 L28 L40 L45 L49) and G-D R1–R7. 34 − 5 riders = 29: the count is right.
- Nothing beyond the rows: every changed line in the 19 files maps to one listed item. The only non-itemised text change is the rewrap of `area-lease.md` :48–50 (same three lines, same words minus the L38 quote). Right.
- Held-out lines are untouched: C1–C5 (`execution-duties.md` :17 and `instrument-discipline.md` :10 are not in the diff; `lanes/eval.md` :23 and the two `filing-gate.md` lines, the ten-card clean-up line and the `User` line, read unchanged on the head). Riders L19 L20 L46 (`lanes/mobile.md`, `lanes/cloud.md`) and L41 L50 (`seat-post-protocol.md`, `SKILL.md` :179) are not touched. X1 and X2 lines (`rest-channel.md`, `readings-search.md`, `readings-channels.md` GraphQL-pool and red-window lines) read unchanged. Right.
- Ratchet: nine ceilings lowered, each equal to the head's `wc -l` (SKILL.md 328, dispatch-runbook 245, contract-review 62, seat-lifecycle 99, filing-gate 79, lanes/director 81, readings-queue 86, readings-channels 71, readings-write-shapes 81) and each equal to old ceiling minus the file's net numstat. The ten files with net 0 keep their rows. No ceiling raised, no headroom added. Honest.
- Gate verdicts are the check-runs on this head: all `success` or `skipped`, none failing, among them `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `PR-body guards` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard`.

### ② Semver level

Clause-②: no — correct. No `packages/spec` contract, no published package and no changeset-bearing path is in the diff; `skip-changeset` matches what the diff publishes (nothing), and `Check Changeset` is skipped on the head accordingly.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Dev `open_questions` (one): who applies the PR body revised for G-D. Answered: the live PR body carries the G-D section and the two-group brief, so option A was applied.
- Dev out-of-scope notes: `lanes/eval.md` :25 keeps the daily cadence of the 问数基线; `compile-surfaces.md` :19 keeps 「冻结状态变化」 as a trigger; `area-lease.md` :10 keeps the inline quote 「比如增加分区」. None is itemised in the ruled tables, so leaving them is the ruled scope. They are named in the PR's Acceptance notes. Answered; the first is N3 below.
- Landing condition, for the seat, not a finding on the tree: nine values leave the text and the PR writes none of their destinations (project memory, the eval, QA and triage seat posts, the eval epic card, the drift-check script card). The PR body lists each value verbatim with its destination. After the merge the `batch:` row has no default, ceiling or per-container cap in the text, and the ceiling is the maintainer's own ruling. The destination writes belong in the same stroke as the landing, and the card stays open until they read back, as the ruling record already says.
- Tier: `SKILL.md` is a MANDATORY-tier path built at the default tier under the claim's stated exit (two mechanical lines). This record is the compensation the claim names; both lines are judged in ④.
- SQL push-down: not applicable, no query code in the diff.
- R6: the PR text reads only "Deleted: superseded by the relay's rerun operation (`readings-ci.md`)". It says nothing about permissions or other routes. `readings-ci.md` :4–5 and `SKILL.md` :103 on the head do carry the relay rerun, so the pointer is true.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix, no should-fix.

Per file, against the ruled row and the live tree:

- `SKILL.md`: L1 cell now points at project memory; the slot definition is intact. L49 row deleted; `filing-gate.md` :62 still carries the standing 「⛔ 不打 `target:`」, so the prohibition is not lost with the row. Holds.
- `area-lease.md`: L3 (both lines), L37, L38, L39. The fill-on-empty and one-PR-in-queue-before-the-next shape stays. L38's rule stays as 「他道席在线只通知」. L39: `AGENTS.md` :50 on the head carries the standing Chinese-with-the-maintainer rule, so nothing is lost. Holds; see N1.
- `compile-surfaces.md`: L10. The row keeps both drivers and both locations. The marker cell becomes 「6、7」 and the note 「两个驱动各一面」; no other line in the file or tree states a surface count that this contradicts. Holds.
- `contract-review.md`: L34. The route the quotes backed stands in the lines above (hand-off line, review seat, sibling seat). Holds.
- `decision-analysis.md`: L35. Rule kept, provenance half gone. Holds.
- `dispatch-runbook.md`: L26, L28, L30, L31, L32. The backlog alarm above L26 and the two mechanical flags after L28 stay. The L31 example keeps its teaching and loses the id. Holds; see N2.
- `filing-gate.md`: L21, L22. The four filing classes and the p2 rule stay. The C3 and C4 lines are byte-identical. Holds.
- `landing-operations.md`: L33, id only. Holds.
- `lanes/director.md`: L42 keeps 「必须人工决裁」 and the three prohibitions; L43 provenance line gone; L44 keeps report-not-gate. Holds.
- `lanes/eval.md`: L11 keeps 「定时归本席自控(维护者令)」; L13, L14, L15 as ruled; the C5 line untouched. Holds; see N3.
- `lanes/qa.md`: L16 reworded tense-free, L17 pointer. Holds.
- `lanes/queue.md`: L45 reworded to the role, the conflict-of-interest reason kept. Holds.
- `lanes/triage.md`: L18. Holds as ruled; see N4.
- `readings-channels.md`: R1, R2, R4, R6. R4's two lines agree with `rest-channel.md` :11 and :18 on the head (the `direct` fallback under the seat's own user). The account-suspension line is kept. Of the lines R4 removes, the 422 on requesting the PR author is still carried by `SKILL.md` :206. Holds.
- `readings-queue.md`: R2 keeps the relay line and drops the two 429 lines; R3 line gone. The review-request line that follows still reads on its own. Holds.
- `readings-session.md`: R7, conclusion only; the two lines after it unchanged. Holds.
- `readings-shell.md`: R1, the general lesson kept with the premise corrected. Holds.
- `readings-write-shapes.md`: R3, R5 deleted; the REST card-create line kept; `rest-channel.md` :43 still carries the never-use rule for that channel. Holds.
- `seat-lifecycle.md`: L40 deleted after the on-hold query the row asked for (20 open, 0 restarting on a milestone summary, listed in the PR). The maintainer's rule in the two lines above is untouched. Holds.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: agrees with the tree line for line (see ①). The new comments name the card, which is where provenance belongs.

No new current value entered the skill text: no count, date, seat name, card number or comment id was added. The two added statements of fact (`gh` is present in the container; routine writes go through the relay under the fleet bot) sit in the readings files and are the analysis's own measured readings.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; none needs a head change):

- N1 (nit) — `area-lease.md` :45 drops the per-area dev count with no pointer on that line. The pointer exists on :10 and in the `SKILL.md` batch row, but the PR body says each moved value keeps a pointer. Follow-up at most.
- N2 (nit) — PR body, L31 row: it names the placeholder as `A′ · RULING-RECORD-ID`; the tree carries a Chinese placeholder for the ruling-record id. The tree is fine; the body sentence can be corrected without moving the head.
- N3 (nit) — `lanes/eval.md` :25 still states the daily cadence that L11 moved out of :7. Not itemised, already in Acceptance notes; one word for the next eval-lane text PR.
- N4 (nit) — L18 turns a prohibition on the triage seat (no second seat, no change of fire frequency) into a pointer to a post that seat itself writes. The move is ruled; the destination write should carry both prohibitions in the maintainer's terms so the polarity survives.
- N5 (nit) — `project-forms.md` :29 calls project memory this account's cache, while L1 and L3 now send fleet-wide numbers there as their only home. Both follow standing text (`filing-gate.md` :19) and the ruled row; worth one line when the project-memory entry is written, or a follow-up card.
